book.name: Kolose
book.title: Paulus susura na fee lahenda kamahereꞌ rai kota Kolose

content: Basa malaka ra! Emi muste ator ata mara no matetuꞌ, ma beibeberaꞌ. Mafarereneꞌ te, emi boe manuu Ramatuaꞌ nai nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a fo ator emi.
Lelea-nonoreꞌ
Emi muste makate hule-haradoi. Kalu emi hule-haradoi, sona muste tebe-tebe ma meniꞌ daleꞌ fo henuꞌ no makasi, bosoꞌ duꞌa-afi hata fekeꞌ.

Bosoꞌ mafarene henin hule-haradoi fee ami, hule fo Manetualain soi enoꞌ, ela ami bisa tui lahenda hata fo maulu na nananafuniꞌ laꞌeneuꞌ Kristus. Mafarereneꞌ te, au masoꞌ bui a, nana huu au afada lahenda laꞌeneuꞌ Kristus.
Hule-haradoi fo au bisa tui-beka Tutui Malole a no matetuꞌ, ela lahenda bisa bubuluꞌ ratalololen.
Masoda no roo-tetuꞌ nai lahenda fo bei ta ramahere Kristus a, talada. Pake matalolole fai lelaꞌ fo Manetualain feen neuꞌ emi.

Maneniko emi dedea, sona dedea no balaroe-balanauꞌ. Dedea sona laꞌe lahenda dalen, ela sira bosoꞌ doaꞌ neuꞌ emi dedeam. Pake dedea roo-tetuꞌ, fo maneniko lahenda ratane emi, sona bisa mataa matafaliꞌ asa no malole.
Paulus duiꞌ nateꞌe susura na

Tikikus sakaꞌ mai tui fee emi laꞌeneuꞌ au leleo-lalaꞌo ki. Ria nana, ami toranoo susuem fo riꞌ dite-tama nahere nalalau Ramatuaꞌ a lahenda nara. Maulu na, ria boe sama-sama noo au nalalaꞌo Ramatuaꞌ a nonoi-tataon.
Au adenu ni, fo ana bisa neu natetea emi dale mara, ma bisa tui emi laꞌeneuꞌ ami nai ia.
Au adenu Onesimus fali, fo tuka noo ni boe. Onesimus nana, toranoo susueꞌ fo dite-tama nahere. Ria nana, emi lahendam. Sira dua, neuꞌ ko tui emi laꞌeneuꞌ basa hata fo dadiꞌ nai ia so a.

Aristakus haitua fee emi haraoe soda-moleꞌ. Ara ena ni nai bui a, sama-sama no au. Barnabas toranoo na anan fo, nade Markus haitua haraoe soda-moleꞌ boe. Maulu na, au helu memaꞌ emi ae, maneniko Markus mai dama emi, sona sipoꞌ ana no malole.

Yesus, (fo taloo ni tae, “Yustus”) ana haitua fee emi haraoe soda-moleꞌ boe. Neme basa tia-lai fo sama-sama ralalaꞌo Manetualain nonoi-tataon, noi sira telu siꞌ dadi lahenda Saraniꞌ neme lahenda nusa Yahudi a mai. Ma sira siꞌ tao ratetea au dale ka.

Emi tiam Epafras nai ia, ma ana haitua fee emi haraoe soda-moleꞌ boe. Ana dadi neuꞌ Yesus Kristus atan. Ana hule-haradoi naroo fee emi, ma hule fo Manetualain tao natetea emi namaherem, ma tao na emi bubuluꞌ matetuꞌ Ria hihii-nanaun.
Au afada memaꞌ emi ae, Epafras noi-tao sota nan seli fee emi, ma fee lahenda Saraniꞌ ara rai kota Laodikia ma kota Herapolis.
Haraoe soda-moleꞌ neme Demas, no doter Lukas, fo riꞌ ita sue-lai!
Au haitua haraoe soda-moleꞌ fee toranoo kamahereꞌ fo rai kota Laodikia. Bosoꞌ mafarene henin malosaꞌ au haraoe soda-mole ka fee Mama Nimfa no basa lahenda kamahereꞌ, fo biasa rabua rai uma na.
Maneniko emi basa nai Kolose, lees basa susuraꞌ ia, sona haituan fee lahenda kamahereꞌ rai kota Laodikia, ela sira bisa lees boe. Ma emi muste lees susuraꞌ fo au parnaa haitua fee si so a.
Mafarereneꞌ fee Arkipus mae, “O bosoꞌ mafarene henin malalaꞌo mabasa nonoi lakaꞌ, fo o sipo neme Ramatuaꞌ a mai so a.”
Bosoꞌ mafarene henin mae, ara bei ena au nai bui daleꞌ ia. Au hule fo Manetualain natudu dale malole Na neuꞌ emi. Au riꞌ lima-ree mata ki susuraꞌ ia.
